title: Work together on a file
objective: Double two rooks on one file, then advance the leading rook with support.

commentary_source.name: Uroschess original practice lesson
commentary_source.attribution: Original practice position and teaching text; not a historical game

steps.explanation: Your rook on d2 occupies an open file. Bring the other rook to d1, behind it, so the rooks can work together.

question.prompt: Put your second rook behind the rook on d2.
hints: The a1 rook can move across the first rank.

tree.feedback: Rd1 doubles your rooks on the d-file. The rear rook protects the leading rook on d2.
Rb1 moves the rook, but does not join its partner on the d-file.

question.other_legal_move_text: That move is legal but is not reviewed for this task. Read the question again or try a hint.

steps.explanation: Black moved the king to h7. Your leading rook can enter the seventh rank with check. The rook behind it will still protect the square it reaches.

question.prompt: Advance the leading rook to the seventh rank with check.
hints: Move the rook on d2 up the open d-file.

tree.feedback: Rd7+ enters the seventh rank with check. Your rook on d1 protects the rook on d7.
Rd6 stays protected on the file, but does not give the requested seventh-rank check.

question.other_legal_move_text: That move is legal but is not reviewed for this task. Read the question again or try a hint.

takeaway: Two rooks on an open file can support each other. Advance the leading rook when its entry square is safe and the rear rook can still protect it.
